findings.summary: Most tracks show no return, only 'פחות מ־3 שנים' (less than 3 years), so the reader can't compare and ends up picking by the one familiar name.
Fees appear only as small, nearly identical percentages, so the reader can't sense the real cost.
The fee header shows two fee types (from savings / from deposit) with no plain explanation, so the main cost figure is hard to understand.
There is no next step or sign-up guidance below the table.
Jargon such as מט"ח (foreign currency) and חשיפה (exposure) in the exposure charts.
The 'הלכה יהודית' (Jewish law) tag and the 'PF-10' code are not explained.
